question_or_report_title: Starred Question No. 102: Status of Appellate Grievances under Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme
representative_name: Edappadi K. Palaniswami (Leader of Opposition / MLA Edappadi)
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
issue_raised: Inquired regarding the total number of applications rejected during initial scrutiny, grounds for rejection, and the timeline for resolving pending appeals submitted by women heads of families.
official_response: Minister for Social Welfare Geetha Jeevan replied that 1.63 crore applications were received; 1.065 crore approved in first phase; 11.85 lakh appeals received via RDO revenue courts of which 8.24 lakh were verified and accepted in expanded Phase 2.
documented_follow_up: Government Order issued directing RDOs to conduct special field verification hearings for pending appeal petitions.
evidence_locator: Assembly Debates Vol. 18, Part II, Columns 142-158

question_or_report_title: Unstarred Question No. 48: Inclusion of Aided School Girl Students in Pudhumai Penn Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
issue_raised: Requested government to extend the Rs 1,000 monthly higher education entitlement to girl students passing out from government-aided schools in rural and urban areas.
official_response: Minister replied that scheme was specifically designed under G.O. 42 to incentivize enrollment in 100% government schools where dropouts were acute; financial implications of aided school expansion under active review by Finance Department.
documented_follow_up: Finance Department subsequent budget expanded similar entitlement to male students (Tamil Pudhalvan scheme) in government schools.
evidence_locator: Unstarred Questions Register, Entry No. 48, Pages 12-14

question_or_report_title: Calling Attention Motion under Rule 55: Service Conditions and Honorarium of Women Health Volunteers under Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam
issue_raised: Raised grievances regarding the monthly incentive of Rs 4,500 paid to 10,969 Women Health Volunteers (WHVs) conducting doorstep screening and demanded minimum wage standardization.
official_response: Minister for Health Ma. Subramanian stated that monthly volunteer incentive was raised to Rs 5,000 with additional mobile allowance of Rs 500, noting WHVs work as honorary community workers under National Health Mission norms.
documented_follow_up: Government Order (Ms) No. 128 issued by Health Department notifying revised monthly honorarium.
evidence_locator: Assembly Debates Vol. 16, Part IV, Columns 310-324

question_or_report_title: Discussion on Demand No. 45: Expansion of Chief Minister Breakfast Scheme to Rural Panchayats
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
issue_raised: Commended the pilot breakfast scheme and urged immediate universal extension to all village panchayat primary schools to prevent disparity between urban and rural children.
official_response: Chief Minister M.K. Stalin intervened on the floor to announce that universal expansion to all 31,008 government primary schools across village panchayats and towns would take effect from August 2023 with Rs 500 Crore budget.
documented_follow_up: Cabinet approved statewide expansion on June 7, 2023; launched across all 38 districts on August 25, 2023.
evidence_locator: Assembly Debates Vol. 17, Part I, Columns 88-102

question_or_report_title: Starred Question No. 15: Progress of Dumpsite Bio-mining at Kodungaiyur and Perungudi
department: Municipal Administration and Water Supply Department
issue_raised: Inquired about the status of bio-mining remediation of legacy waste at Kodungaiyur and Perungudi dumpsites and timeline for reclaiming wetlands.
official_response: Minister for Municipal Administration K.N. Nehru stated that out of 30.6 lakh cubic meters at Perungudi, 22.4 lakh cubic meters (73%) stood processed; Kodungaiyur bio-mining project worth Rs 640 Crore awarded and scheduled for completion by 2025.
documented_follow_up: GCC monthly monitoring register published online on corporation portal.
evidence_locator: Assembly Debates Vol. 18, Part III, Columns 45-60
